title: Acassist Module
description: The shared module contract (spec 00). A module is one plain JSON file: lesson content, quiz content, or both. Quiz answers ship as salt + answer_hash only — never plaintext.

schema_version.description: Locked at 1.0 for the event. Bump only on a shape change.

_note.description: Optional human note (e.g. placeholder-hash warning on the fixture). Ignored by renderers.

type.description: Renderer switch. A module may still carry both lesson and quiz content regardless of this hint; sequence lesson -> quiz when both present.

grade_level.description: Presentation metadata only — NEVER affects scoring.

kind.description: MUST kinds for the event. Unknown kinds are ROADMAP; renderers ignore unknown kinds safely.

hash_algo.description: The only algorithm for the event.

normalization.description: The contract string both seal (teacher) and check (Rust core) obey. Must match the authoritative normalizer.

id.description: Stable — part of the hash input. Immutable once sealed; never renumber or reuse.

options.description: Required for multiple_choice/true_false (the text that gets hashed). Omitted for identification. Enforced by the allOf rules below.

salt.description: Per-question random salt (hex), shipped in the file. Hash input — immutable once sealed.

answer_hash.description: SHA-256(id : normalized_answer : salt), hex. The sealed answer. No plaintext answer anywhere in the file.
